issue.title: Notebooks — a home for notes under areas and projects
issue.description: Bob gains a `type: "[[notebook]]"` note kind for task-free note bullets (optionally under `##` sections) that always hangs under an area, project, or notebook. Capture writes notes into notebooks through the existing `@nb` forms, creates notebooks with `@parent^id@ %n <summary>`, and every area or project shows a beautiful generated `## Notebooks` catalog. 26 existing notes, 11 of them rescued from the zorg dead end, become the first notebooks.
